product_metadata.title: Boxiki Kitchen Non-Stick Steel Jumbo 6 Cup Muffin Pan with Silicone Handles and Reusable Liners - Perfect for Baking Large Muffins and Cupcakes
features: Non-Stick: Our 6-cup muffin pan is made with heavy-gauge steel that is coated with a non-stick coating, making it easy to release your baked goods without leaving any residue behind.

Reuseable Silicone Liners: Say goodbye to disposable paper cups and hello to eco-friendly baking with our 6 included silicone liners. Made with food-grade silicone, these liners are reusable and can withstand temperatures up to 420°F.

Comfortable Silicone Handles: Our pan's handles are designed with silicone grips that provide a comfortable and secure grip, even when wearing oven mittens. This allows you to easily remove the pan from the oven without the risk of burns.

Versatile Recipe Possibilities: This large muffin pan is not just for muffins and cupcakes, it's also perfect for mini cakes, quiche, tart, mini omelets, lasagnas, meatloaf, and more. The possibilities are endless with this pan in your kitchen.

Oven and Freezer Safe: This muffin pan is made to withstand high temperatures, making it safe for use in the oven and freezer. It can withstand temperatures up to 420°F, giving you the flexibility to bake a wide variety of treats.
